messages.text: In two sentences, what does studio/render.py do? Do not change any files.

studio/render.py turns a blueprint (a list of scenes, each with narration, a visual search query, and optional on-screen text) into a finished 1080x1920 vertical MP4 by synthesizing a voice-over for each scene (Kokoro TTS, falling back to gTTS), downloading matching portrait stock footage from Pexels, and compositing the clips with a darkening shade, timed word-by-word captions, and headline text over the synced audio.

It exposes a `render()` function that writes the output video plus a thumbnail and returns their paths and total duration, reporting progress through callbacks along the way.
